cohort: A total of 284 patients diagnosed with ureteral stones who underwent ureteroscopic lithotripsy between December 2020 and May 2022 at a single hospital were included.
finding: NP-URL significantly reduced operative duration, incidence of postoperative fever, stone retropulsion rate, and adjunct procedure rate, while achieving a higher primary stone-free rate compared to S-URL, though final stone-free rates were similar.
